title: A Well for the Bell
author: Tamsin Okafor
blurb: Ada Lockridge, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
